_comment: Offline CVE signatures for services Bjorn targets. Matched against the product+version nmap -sV reports (via CPE), so no internet is needed. Extend freely: 'product' is the nmap CPE product (lowercase); give exactly one version rule per entry -- 'version' (exact), 'version_contains' (substring), or 'version_lt' (naive numeric compare, vulnerable if detected version < this). High-signal, version-detectable CVEs only; this is a seed list, not a full NVD mirror.
